- Avoid over-optimism in early forecast periods (especially after sentiment spikes); model tends to overestimate prices when sentiment is positive.
- When sentiment is negative or neutral, reduce forecast magnitude; model often underreacts to bearish sentiment.
- Correct for lagged overreaction: if sentiment turns positive, model still forecasts high values for several days; adjust downward gradually.
- Suppress extreme outliers in forecast tails (especially >3x mean or >2.5x recent high); model frequently over-estimates tail risks after spikes.
- Apply mean reversion bias correction: if forecast is >1.5x recent 7-day average, reduce by 15–30% unless sentiment strongly supports it.
- For 30-day horizon, reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is stable; model tends to over-predict volatility in flat sentiment periods.
- If sentiment is consistently positive over 3+ days, model often over-estimates 30d price; apply 10–20% downward adjustment.
- Avoid forecasting sharp spikes after recent lows; model tends to over-forecast recovery after dips.
